lines.text: When the King speaks a word, it cannot be overturned, it's as good as done
lines.text_sk: Keď Kráľ povie slovo, nemožno ho zvrátiť, je to, akoby sa stalo

lines.text: And when Heaven touches earth, it can never be reversed, it's the Kingdom come
lines.text_sk: A keď sa Nebo dotkne zeme, nikdy sa to nedá zvrátiť, prichádza Kráľovstvo

lines.text: So get the lies out the way, they don't have the final say, there is only One
lines.text_sk: Takže preč s klamstvami, nemajú posledné slovo, je tu iba Jeden

lines.text: Sovereign Supreme, every word He speaks is Holy
lines.text_sk: Zvrchovaný Najvyšší, každé slovo, ktoré povie, je Sväté

lines.text: The realm of God has overcome
My testimony is He's good
lines.text_sk: Moje svedectvo je, že On je dobrý

lines.text: And if He said that it is done, it is done, so be it God

lines.text: To the One on the throne who cannot be overthrown, sing Hallelujah

lines.text: To the Last and the First, Ruler of the universe, sing Hallelujah

lines.text: To the Alpha, Omega, the Master, the Maker, the Name above...
